model_annotations.Bulgarian: The figure illustrates the change in the absolute mean of hidden states across different network layers, comparing three different conditions: the hidden state mean before a gate, the hidden state mean after a gate, and the hidden state mean of a baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number in the network and ranges from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," represents the absolute mean value and ranges from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot contains three distinct lines: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts at a value of approximately 0.05 at layer 0, remains relatively stable around 0.05 until layer 18, and then sharply increases to a value of approximately 0.71 at layer 22; an orange dotted line representing the "hidden state mean after gate," which remains nearly constant at a value of approximately 0.05 across all layers from 0 to 22; and a green solid line representing the "hidden state mean of baseline," which starts at a value of approximately 0.04 at layer 0 and gradually decreases to a value of approximately 0.02 at layer 22.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph displays the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, comparing three distinct metrics: the hidden state mean before the gate, the hidden state mean after the gate, and the hidden state mean of the baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number and spans from 0 to 25 with a linear scale, marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," represents the absolute mean value and ranges from 0 to 4 on a linear scale, with major ticks at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line, corresponding to the "hidden state mean before gate," starts at an absolute mean of approximately 0.5 at layer 0, decreases to a minimum of about 0.2 around layer 12, and then sharply increases to a value of approximately 2.5 at layer 25. The orange dotted line, representing the "hidden state mean after gate," remains consistently low, fluctuating between 0.02 and 0.04 across all layers. The green solid line, indicating the "hidden state mean of baseline," starts at a value of approximately 0.3 at layer 0, gradually decreases to a minimum of about 0.1 around layer 20, and then shows a slight increase to approximately 0.2 at layer 25.
model_annotations.English: The plot displays the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, with the x-axis labeled "Layer" ranging from 0 to 25 in increments of 5, and the y-axis labeled "Abs Mean" ranging from 0 to 4. Three distinct lines represent different conditions: a blue dashed line labeled "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71" starts near 0.1 at layer 0, decreases to a minimum around 0.05 at layer 15, and then sharply increases to approximately 0.75 at layer 25; an orange dotted line labeled "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05" remains consistently low, starting near 0.01 at layer 0 and staying below 0.02 across all layers; a green solid line labeled "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04" begins at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, gradually decreases to about 0.01 at layer 25, and remains the lowest among the three lines throughout.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den Verlauf des absoluten Mittelwerts der versteckten Zustände über verschiedene Schichten, wobei drei verschiedene Zustandsgrößen verglichen werden: der versteckte Zustand vor dem Gate (blau, gestrichelt), der versteckte Zustand nach dem Gate (orange, punktiert) und der versteckte Zustand der Baseline (grün, durchgezogen). Die x-Achse ist als „Layer“ beschriftet und repräsentiert die Schichtnummer, mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 25, wobei die Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 angegeben sind. Die y-Achse ist als „Abs Mean“ beschriftet und zeigt den absoluten Mittelwert, mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 4, wobei die Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 1 angegeben sind. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0,05 bei Layer 0, bleibt zunächst nahe bei 0,05 bis Layer 15, fällt dann leicht ab, erreicht bei Layer 18 einen Tiefpunkt von etwa 0,03, steigt dann stark an und endet bei Layer 25 bei einem Wert von etwa 0,71. Die orange punktierte Linie beginnt bei etwa 0,05 bei Layer 0, bleibt überwiegend unter 0,05 und endet bei etwa 0,04 bei Layer 25. Die grüne durchgezogene Linie beginnt bei etwa 0,05 bei Layer 0, fällt kontinuierlich und stabilisiert sich bei etwa 0,04 bei Layer 25.
